name: Danielle Romero
office: City of Montebello, Member of the City Council, 4th District (Unexpired term ending November 7, 2028)

items.text: Danielle Romero is the Mayor Pro Tem of Montebello, representing District 4 on the City Council since February 2025. She is a U.S. Army veteran and works as a Veteran Service Officer for the American Legion Los Angeles County Council. Before joining the council, she served on the city’s Traffic and Safety Commission. She also acts as the city’s delegate to the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments.
